queue.title: AI-assisted documentation study / 文档研究

hypotheses.claim: Source-linked AI drafts reduce unsupported statements.
hypotheses.source: Synthetic pilot: 4 unsupported statements among 20 draft claims.
hypotheses.prediction: A source-linked prompt produces at most 1 unsupported claim in 20.
hypotheses.falsifier: More than 1 of 20 claims lacks a supporting passage.
hypotheses.method: Compare two prompts on the same 20 synthetic questions; a reviewer checks every cited passage.

hypotheses.claim: A checklist reduces review time without reducing accuracy.
hypotheses.source: Synthetic review log: median 12 minutes per document.
hypotheses.prediction: Median time falls below 9 minutes while unsupported-claim recall stays at least 90%.
hypotheses.falsifier: Median time is 9 minutes or more, or recall is below 90%.
hypotheses.method: Counterbalance 10 paired documents and record time and missed claims.

hypotheses.source: AI-generated proposal; no pilot evidence yet.
hypotheses.prediction: Readers distinguish unsupported statements more accurately.

hypotheses.claim: A small glossary reduces terminology mismatches.
hypotheses.source: Synthetic baseline: 5 mismatches across 30 term uses.
hypotheses.prediction: At most 2 mismatches across the same 30 uses.
hypotheses.method: Blindly label each term use using the same glossary and count mismatches.

policy: Priority 1 first, then smaller effort, then ID. Skip work that does not fit. Planning only; outcomes are user-supplied.
